# wedge_entry -- 2-D wedge water-entry reference numbers (Track B stage B8)

Transcribed numbers only (no PDF stored). Read 2026-10-07 with WebFetch / text extraction of the arXiv versions.
- `zf1993_similarity_wedge.csv`: Zhao & Faltinsen (1993) similarity solution (peak pressure and its height), secondary
  transcription from Iafrati & Battistin (arXiv 1212.6699, Table 1, p. 17).
- `wedge_pmax_models_2011.10378.csv`: peak pressures of OLM, MLM, GWM, exact-integral and composite models
  ("On wedge-slamming pressures", arXiv 2011.10378v3, Table 1).
- `wen2022_transition_constants.csv`: constants of the transition-stage (chine-wetted) force similitude of Wen et al.
  (2022, arXiv 2201.00959), eqs 16-24 (registered empirical element E-B8-1 of learn/meta/EMPIRICAL_REGISTER_RANKINE.md).
Used by hydro/rankine/planing_nl.py, studies/rankine_planing_b8.py (rows W2A, W2C, W2P, W2Z).
